blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Subduction takes place when a denser oceanic plate descends into the mantle under a lighter plate.
Deep-sea trenches are formed along subduction zones.
The process is responsible for generating powerful earthquakes.
Subduction leads to significant volcanic activity.
Subduction strictly involves a denser oceanic plate sinking beneath a lighter plate into the mantle.
Questions frequently test the three geological consequences of subduction: deep-sea trenches, powerful earthquakes, and volcanic activity.
